candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student for Edge AI Technology Scouting and Evaluation
letter.greeting: Dear NXP Edge AI Tooling & Methodologies team,
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Edge AI technology scouting and evaluation. Comparing approaches hands-on, measuring them fairly and writing up what works is the part of machine learning I enjoy most.
letter.profile_intro: I am in the first year of my M.Sc. Data Science at TU Ilmenau, after a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence, so I can commit to the requested part-time hours for at least a year.

achievements.impact: in DocuMind I compared semantic, BM25 and hybrid retrieval with hit rate and MRR, and wrote up where each won and why
I fine-tuned a pretrained EfficientNet-B0 in PyTorch that reached 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set
I documented data sources, methods and results for every dashboard and project I built, for technical and business readers

letter.problems_section: I would follow new tools for model optimization, compilers and inference runtimes, build small proofs of concept, compare them and summarise the results in clear reports. I have not used ONNX Runtime, LiteRT or ExecuTorch yet, and this role is the right place to learn them.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Munich and can start immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
